item.tib: dpal ldan lha mo yang snying gi rgyud las nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa
item.coloph: de ltar nor sgrab gter gyi bum pa 'di/ drin chen ye shes snying po'i bka' nan dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bla ma yi dam rnams la mthol lo bshags/ mkha' 'gro bon skyongs (skyong) rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i (bas) 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
